scan.title: Scan the network
scan.description:
Home Assistant checks every address of its local network for an MPC-HC web interface on the port below. The scan starts when you submit this form and only connects to that port.

The PC must be on, and MPC-HC must have the web interface enabled with **"Allow access from localhost only"** unticked (*View → Options → Player → Web Interface*).

⚠️ **Security warning:** the web server has no authentication or encryption. Consider allowing the port in the Windows firewall only for the Home Assistant IP address.

select_device.title: Select the player
select_device.description: These players were found. The name is used as the device name and in entity IDs.

manual.title: Connect MPC-HC
manual.description:
Enter the address of the PC that runs MPC-HC.

**Setting up MPC-HC (once, on the PC):**
1. *View → Options → Player → Web Interface*
2. Tick **Listen on port** and set the port (default: 13579)
3. **Untick "Allow access from localhost only".** If it stays enabled, only the PC itself can reach the web server, not Home Assistant.

⚠️ **Security warning:** the web server has no authentication or encryption. Once the localhost restriction is lifted, anyone on the network can control the player and see the screenshot. Consider allowing the port in the Windows firewall only for the Home Assistant IP address.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name and used in entity IDs, e.g. "MPC-HC Living room"
data_description.host: Default: 127.0.0.1 (only right if Home Assistant and MPC-HC run on the same machine)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MPC-HC
reconfigure.description: Change the name or the address of the PC. Entities and history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: No response. Check that the PC is on, MPC-HC is running with the web interface enabled, and that the IP, port and firewall are correct.
error.localhost_only: MPC-HC accepted the connection but closed it immediately. This usually means 'Allow access from localhost only' is still enabled (View → Options → Player → Web Interface).
error.not_mpc_hc: The address responds, but it does not look like the MPC-HC web interface.
error.already_configured: An MPC-HC with this host and port is already added.
error.no_devices_found: No MPC-HC found. Check that the PC is on, MPC-HC is running with the web interface enabled, and that the Windows firewall allows the port. You can also enter the address manually.
error.localhost_only_found: Something accepts connections on this port but closes them right away. This is probably MPC-HC with 'Allow access from localhost only' enabled (View → Options → Player → Web Interface).
error.all_configured: Every player that was found is already added.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a raw MPC-HC command code (WM_COMMAND) to the player.

command.name: Command
command.description: The numeric command code, e.g. 956 for subtitles on/off.
